goal: Test whether the ordered gap composition of 6-of-49 draws contains stable pre-draw structure that produces a top-8 number pool with more 5-of-6 coverage than an equal-window marginal-frequency baseline and an exact random pool.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: v308 models number co-occurrence graph geometry; v320 models the seven ordered empty-slot gaps of each sorted 6/49 combination.
v319 models each number's binary temporal history; v320 ignores temporal binary contexts and models within-draw ordered composition geometry.

representation.bijection: Every 6-subset of 1..49 corresponds to exactly one nonnegative 7-part composition of 43 and vice versa.

model.training: For each of the seven gap positions separately, count gap values 0..43 in a frozen trailing window of target-game draws strictly before the target.
model.compositionWeight: For a candidate gap vector summing to 43, unnormalized weight is product_i q_i(g_i). The sum=43 constraint is imposed exactly.
model.marginalization: Use forward/backward dynamic programming over gap index and remaining sum to compute exact conditional marginal inclusion weight for every number 1..49 without enumerating all C(49,6) combinations.
model.selection: Rank numbers by exact conditional inclusion probability, descending; ties by number ascending; select top 8.
model.nestedBaseline: Trailing marginal inclusion frequency for each number over the same target-game window with Laplace 1 smoothing; top 8, same tie rule.
